properties.description: This three-bedroom flat is arranged over the first and second floors of a terraced property on Harrington Road, London, SE25. The accommodation comprises three bedrooms, one bathroom, one reception room and a separate fitted kitchen. Access is provided from the ground-floor entrance, with stairs leading to the first-floor landing. The reception room is positioned at the front of the first floor and has windows overlooking the street, fitted carpet, a radiator and a ceiling light. It provides the principal living space and includes built-in shelving or storage recesses formed within the room layout. Bedroom 2 is also located on the first floor and is a double-sized room with a front-facing window, fitted carpet, radiator and ceiling light. Bedroom 3 is a smaller single room positioned towards the front or side of the first floor, with a window, fitted carpet, radiator and ceiling light. The kitchen is located towards the rear of the first floor and is fitted along two walls with light wood-effect wall and base units, dark work surfaces and tiled splashback areas. Appliances visible in the kitchen include a built-in electric oven, a four-ring gas hob, stainless-steel extractor hood, washing machine and sink with mixer tap. There is also space and provision for additional kitchen appliances, together with a rear-facing window providing natural light. The bathroom is positioned off the first-floor landing and includes a bath with shower fittings, washbasin, WC, mirrored cabinet and a small frosted window. The room has tiled walls and floor, a heated towel rail or radiator and an extractor fan. Stairs lead from the first-floor landing to the second floor, where the main bedroom occupies the upper level. This room extends beneath the sloping roof and includes a rooflight, radiator, fitted carpet and extensive built-in cupboards across the rear wall. The floor plan identifies eaves areas at both ends of the second floor, with reduced head height below 1.5 metres in the designated sections. These areas provide storage space in addition to the fitted cupboards within the bedroom. The property has white-painted walls and wood-effect flooring in the kitchen, with carpeted flooring in the reception room and bedrooms. Windows are double glazed and the rooms are heated by radiators connected to the central heating system. Externally, the property has a paved front approach enclosed by a low brick wall, with the entrance door opening directly from the frontage. The surrounding properties are predominantly terraced residential homes, with the address situated within the London postcode district SE25. Local amenities and services are available within the wider Harrington Road and SE25 area, while the address provides a residential setting with access to the surrounding streets and facilities of London. The approximate floor area is 1,157 sq ft, or 107.5 sq m, including eaves, with approximately 238 sq ft, or 22.1 sq m, identified as limited-use area. Property Reference: 2982874.
 A furnished three-bedroom mid-terrace house on a quiet residential street in Tooting, refurbished throughout in 2020 and three minutes' walk from St George's Hospital.
 There are two double bedrooms and a third smaller room that works well as a home office, nursery or guest room. Two bathrooms make a real difference to a household of two or more: a bathroom with a bath on the ground floor, and a shower room upstairs. The kitchen and dining space are open to one another, with a gas hob, oven and dishwasher, and there's a separate living room. A washing machine and tumble dryer are installed in the hallway. There's a good amount of storage for a house this size — a floored loft and a shed in the garden.
 The garden at the back is paved and low-maintenance, facing north-west so it catches the afternoon and evening sun, which is the useful end of the day if you're out at work. Outdoor furniture, a barbecue and a fire pit are all included.
 The location is the standout. St George's Hospital is a three-minute walk. Tooting Broadway station is ten minutes on foot (Northern line, Zone 3), putting the City and West End within an easy commute, and Earlsfield is a ten-minute bus ride, with direct National Rail services to Clapham Junction and Waterloo. Tooting Broadway's covered markets, independent restaurants and bars are minutes from the door, and Tooting Bec Common and the Lido are a walk in the other direction.
 Full fibre broadband is already installed — currently with Community Fibre, and Virgin Media is also available at the address. There's a secure Cyclehoop bike hangar on the street, and parking is by resident permit.
 One practical point worth knowing: the property is in Wandsworth, where council tax is the lowest of any local authority in England. At band D that currently works out at roughly £1,030 a year, against an English average of around £2,390 — a saving of well over £1,000 a year compared with an equivalent house in most neighbouring boroughs.

Enviably located on a quiet residential street close to Blackhorse Road, this beautifully presented Victorian terrace offers more than 1,100 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. Highlights include the spacious kitchen/diner, ground floor WC, first floor family bathroom, superb loft conversion with ensuite and a charming rear garden. With Blackhorse Road station a short walk away, you’ll also have the Victoria line and Overground within easy reach.
IF YOU LIVED HERE…
Behind the handsome Victorian facade, you’ll find a home that strikes a wonderful balance between period character and modern living. Original features sit comfortably alongside contemporary updates, creating a warm and welcoming home that’s ready to enjoy from day one.
At the front, the bright reception room is filled with natural light thanks to the generous bay window, while period details such as the fireplace and original flooring add plenty of character.
To the rear, the spacious kitchen/diner is undoubtedly the heart of the home. Designed with everyday living in mind, there’s ample room for cooking, dining and entertaining, with doors opening directly onto the garden. A ground floor WC add further practicality.
Outside, the rear garden is a lovely extension of the living space, with a decked patio for al fresco dining leading onto shingle, creating a peaceful and private setting.
On the first floor you’ll find two well-proportioned double bedrooms, along with a stylish family bathroom. The top floor has been thoughtfully converted to create an impressive master bedroom, complete with its own ensuite shower room and useful eaves storage.
When it comes to the local area, you’re brilliantly placed. Walthamstow Wetlands is walking distance, while Lloyd Park is a similar distance in the opposite direction, giving you two fantastic green spaces to explore.
You’ll also have some of the area’s best independent spots close by, including SlowBurn and Jaunty Coffee, while the ever-popular Blackhorse Beer Mile is just a short stroll away, home to Big Penny Social, Signature Brew, Exale and plenty more.
For commuters, Blackhorse Road station is a short hop, offering swift Victoria line and Suffragette line services, while nearby St James Street provides direct Weaver line trains to Liverpool Street.
WHAT ELSE?
* Families will appreciate the excellent choice of well-regarded primary and secondary schools nearby.
* Walthamstow High Street, Europe’s longest outdoor market, is within easy reach, alongside the shops, restaurants and cinema at 17¢ral.
* The award-winning Soho Theatre Walthamstow has added another exciting cultural destination to the neighbourhood, complementing an area that’s become one of East London’s most sought-after places to call home.

properties.description:
Situated in one of E17’s most sought-after and well-connected neighbourhoods, this bright three-bedroom home is just a short walk from Walthamstow Central, Walthamstow Village and Lloyd Park. Despite having everything you need on your doorstep, Hurst Road enjoys a peaceful residential setting, offering the perfect balance of convenience and tranquillity.
Spanning over 1,000 square feet, the home offers an exceptional sense of space. Beautifully designed throughout, it features two bright and spacious reception rooms, a separate kitchen, two bathrooms, and a large west-facing garden.
IF YOU LIVED HERE…
You’ve hit the jackpot with this E17 location - some of Walthamstow’s best-loved amenities are right on your doorstep, but there’s just as much to admire inside this beautifully finished home.
At the front is your first reception room, traditional in style and filled with natural light. At the rear, the second reception is equally inviting, with lovely views over the west-facing garden through patio doors. Outside, the garden is wonderfully spacious and low-maintenance, with a real sense of privacy and seclusion.
Back inside, the smart kitchen offers plenty of storage, high-spec appliances and sleek fittings, while a downstairs shower room adds useful everyday convenience.
Upstairs, you’ll find three bedrooms alongside a smart family bathroom, creating a practical and well-balanced layout for family life or those needing plenty of space to work from home.
Beyond your front door, there’s an abundance of nearby green space to enjoy, from Fellowship Square right at the bottom of the road to the beloved Lloyd Park. Hollow Ponds and Walthamstow Wetlands are also within easy reach, giving you plenty of options for weekend trips.
When it comes to eateries, there are heaps of established favourites in the areas around Hoe Street and Orford Road in Walthamstow Village; Tonkotsu, Yard Sale Pizza, Sodo and Shri Lakshmi in the former, and Peeld, Proud May Pizza, Orford’s Fish & Chips and Ruff’s Bistro in the latter, but new arrivals to the scene ensure a steady buzz and feeling of energy. 
Walthamstow Central tube is mere minutes away, meaning you can hop on the Victoria line or Weaver Overground and be in the West End or City at super speed.
WHAT ELSE?
- Soho Theatre Walthamstow, the 1,000-seat performance venue, is a short stroll away. This vibrant space hosts an exciting mix of theatre, comedy, music, and live events, bringing top-quality entertainment right to your neighbourhood. 
- You can also enjoy some excellent entertainment at the wonderfully eclectic Trades Hall, a favoured spot for renowned comedians to perform warm-up sets. Ye Olde Rose & Crown also puts on some excellent shows, including annual pantos. Both venues are about few mins on foot.
- East of Eden of just a hop away, offering yoga and pilates in peaceful surroundings, while the Waltham Forest Feel Good Centre is a short walk in the other direction, where you’ll find a gym with a 400m running track and 25m fitness pool with separate diving pit and teaching pool.

properties.description:
A sleek yet characterful three bedroom terraced home with rear garden sitting on a tree-lined street in Upper Walthamstow. All your day-to-day amenities are close at hand here, and drivers will love being so close to the North Circular.
This arterial thoroughfare is just two minutes from your street for multiple destinations including Chiswick to the west and Woolwich to the east. If international destinations are on the horizon then Stansted Airport awaits, less than thirty minutes' drive.
IF YOU LIVED HERE
You'll be relaxing with friends and family in your flawlessly-finished 165 square foot lounge with leafy views through a quartet of windows, engineered timber floorboards underfoot and an Art Deco style vintage fireplace. Continue through your dual aspect, semi open plan space for reception two 135 square feet and home to a tower radiator, pendulum lighting over the dining area and French doors giving outside access.
Step through here for your forty foot garden where a patio area with a palm tree gives way to a lush lawn flanked by beds ending in a handy shed. Back inside, this time via the lean-to, and your kitchen's a glorious culinary space with a crisp suite of immaculate under-lit white cabinets, a gleaming metro tile backsplash and ebony countertops. Lastly, head past the bespoke under stairs storage and up to the first floor for two impeccable and generous double bedrooms, a similarly-attired single and a gorgeous contemporary white bathroom with a shower over the tub and tankless WC.
Outside and if you're looking for a new local then head to The Dog & Duck for Sunday Roasts, crispy sourdough pizzas and Japanese gin, it's just a six minute stroll around the corner. Take a right just past here onto Cazenove Road and you'll find the entrance to Lloyd Park, the best-loved green space in the borough and home to the William Morris Gallery, a museum devoted to the nineteenth century arts and crafts designer and local legend. Continue on for Hoe Street, one of the most vibrant routes in East London and home to an array of artisan bars, cafes and restaurants.
WHAT ELSE?
- There's a choice of twenty two 'Outstanding' and 'Good' schools within a mile radius. Younger children have a huge choice of nearby nurseries, including Bright Star, Unique Child and Early Buds.
- A quick hop on the W11 or 158 bus just outside will drop you at Blackhorse Road tube where you can be whisked into central London in fifteen minutes on the Victoria Line. Hop off before you get to the station to explore the Walthamstow Beer Mile for five taprooms offering up almost every craft ale under the sun.
- O'Cha Thai restaurant is just four minutes on foot from your front door, it's a great local gem serving up the best authentic massaman curries.

 Hotel grade laptop safe fitted in one of the cupboards.

properties.description:
Set in the heart of Greenwich, this furnished three-bedroom duplex offers generous accommodation arranged over multiple levels, with a spacious open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, three bedrooms, a family bathroom and a private balcony. The property combines practical family living with excellent access to Greenwich's shops, cafés, transport links and major attractions, while Greenwich Park is also within easy reach. Available from 15th October.
The kitchen is arranged in a U-shaped layout with red lower cabinetry, white wall units, granite-effect worktops and tiled splashbacks. It includes a gas hob, oven, sink and space for freestanding appliances, with a large window bringing natural light into the room.
The kitchen opens directly into the dining area, creating a sociable central space with wood flooring and room for a substantial dining table. From here, the accommodation continues into the living area.
The living room is a particularly generous space with wood flooring, recessed ceiling lighting and a feature fireplace. Large windows bring in natural light, while a glazed door provides direct access to the balcony.
The private balcony extends along the rear of the property and provides useful outdoor space with open views across the surrounding rooftops.
The principal bedroom is a well-proportioned double room with carpeted flooring, built-in storage and a large window providing plenty of natural light with views towards Canary Wharf.
The second bedroom is another comfortable room with carpeted flooring, a large window and space for a bed, desk and storage furniture.
The third bedroom is also carpeted and benefits from a large window, with the photographs showing space for a single bed, desk and additional furniture.
The family bathroom is finished with warm-toned tiling and includes a bath with a glass shower screen, WC, wash basin, mirrored storage and a heated towel rail.
Greenwich Park is one of the area's major attractions and green spaces, offering extensive lawns, tree-lined routes and elevated views across London. The park is also home to the Royal Observatory and sits close to the Queen's House and National Maritime Museum.
Greenwich offers a particularly strong mix of historic and cultural attractions. Cutty Sark is within the wider town centre, while Greenwich Market, the riverside and the Old Royal Naval College add to the area's distinctive character. The neighbourhood also has a wide selection of cafés, restaurants, independent shops and everyday amenities around Greenwich High Road and Royal Hill. 
Greenwich station is approximately 200 metres from Prior Street and provides both National Rail and DLR services, while Cutty Sark DLR is also nearby. Greenwich offers direct rail links towards London Bridge and Cannon Street, while DLR services provide connections towards Canary Wharf, Bank, Lewisham and Stratford. Local bus services further connect the area with surrounding parts of south-east and east London.

The property is non-smoking.

properties.description:
A furnished three bedroom flat on the top two floors of Shepard House, giving you 852 sq ft of living space, a balcony of your own and Clapham Junction a short walk from the door.
The front door opens into a reception room with a wide window over the treetops and built-in cupboards along one wall. Alongside it is the kitchen, fitted with beech-fronted units, a speckled granite-effect worktop that curves out into a breakfast bar, a gas hob and tiled splashbacks over stone-effect tiled flooring. A window above the breakfast bar keeps it bright through the morning, and the door beside it opens onto the balcony, screened in obscured glass and set among the mature trees that line this part of the estate.
Beside the kitchen is a study, a room that earns its keep as a home office, a quiet corner away from the television or somewhere to keep the things a flat this size would rather not display. The staircase leads up to the three bedrooms, two of them comfortable doubles and the third a single, all neutrally decorated and carpeted, with wardrobe and drawer space already in place. The largest runs the depth of the building with windows across its width. Serving them is a fully tiled bathroom with a shower over the bath, and a separate WC beside it. Gas central heating and double glazing run throughout.
BETWEEN CLAPHAM JUNCTION AND YORK GARDENS
Clapham Junction is a short walk away, which puts Victoria about six minutes off, Waterloo nine and Gatwick Airport under half an hour, with the Overground's Mildmay and Windrush lines running west towards Richmond and east towards Shoreditch and Whitechapel. Buses leave from the estate itself: the 170 to Victoria, the 295 and C3 towards Earl's Court and Ladbroke Grove, the 344 to Liverpool Street. York Gardens and its library are at the end of the road, the independent shops and street market of Northcote Road are a walk up the hill, and Battersea Park and the river are a short bus ride to the north.
Book a viewing to see the balcony and the kitchen for yourself.

Situated on White Road in Stratford, this well-presented three bedroom terraced house offers comfortable and practical accommodation in a convenient East London location. The property is ideally suited to a family looking for a well-connected home with easy access to local amenities, schools, green spaces and excellent transport links.
The accommodation benefits from three well-proportioned bedrooms, making it a practical choice for family living. The property is mostly unfurnished, with the existing white goods remaining, giving tenants the flexibility to furnish and arrange the home to suit their own requirements. Gas central heating and double glazing are also provided, helping to create a warm and comfortable environment throughout the year.
To the rear, the property has a private courtyard garden, providing a useful outdoor space for relaxing.. The property is available from 17th October and is offered under a selective licence for family occupancy only.
The location is particularly convenient for those looking to enjoy everything Stratford and the surrounding area has to offer. Westfield Stratford City is close by, providing a wide range of shops, restaurants, cafés, leisure facilities and everyday amenities, while Stratford town centre offers further local services and conveniences. The area also benefits from a variety of parks and open spaces, including the extensive Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, which is within easy reach and offers attractive walking routes, green spaces and recreational facilities.
Families will find a good selection of schools in the surrounding area, with a range of primary and secondary schools within Stratford and the wider Newham area. Local schools and their admissions arrangements can vary, so prospective tenants are advised to check the latest Ofsted information and school admission criteria directly with the relevant schools and the local authority.
Transport connections are one of Stratford's major advantages. Stratford Station provides access to the Central and Jubilee Underground lines, the Elizabeth line, London Overground and National Rail services, making journeys into central London and other parts of the capital particularly straightforward. Stratford International is also nearby, providing access to Southeastern high-speed services. Numerous local bus routes operate throughout the area, while road connections provide convenient access towards the City, Canary Wharf and other parts of East London. The Elizabeth line offers particularly quick connections across London, including direct services towards the West End, Paddington and Heathrow.
Overall, this three bedroom terraced house offers a practical family home in a well-connected and vibrant part of Stratford, with excellent transport links, a wide range of amenities and attractive recreational spaces all within easy reach.

properties.description:
A beautifully arranged three bedroom family home with two reception rooms, two bathrooms, a private rear garden and a versatile outbuilding, set on a quiet residential street in Walthamstow.
Kenilworth Avenue enjoys a peaceful setting while remaining close to some of Walthamstow’s best loved destinations. Lloyd Park, Walthamstow Village and Hoe Street are all within easy reach, offering everything from independent cafés and restaurants to open green spaces, while excellent transport links make travelling across London straightforward.
If you lived here…
Step through the front door and you’ll find a home that’s been thoughtfully arranged across three floors. A bright front reception room is centred around a large bay window, creating a welcoming first impression, while a second reception room to the rear opens onto the garden and offers plenty of space for everyday living and entertaining. The separate kitchen sits alongside, finished with contemporary cabinetry, generous worktop space and direct access outside.
Upstairs, the first floor is home to two well proportioned bedrooms and a modern family bathroom. The principal bedroom stretches to over 16ft, providing plenty of room for additional furniture or a home working space, while the second bedroom enjoys views over the rear garden. The converted second floor creates an impressive third bedroom with fitted storage and eaves space, making it an ideal principal suite, guest room or peaceful retreat.
Outside, the private rear garden has been designed for easy maintenance, with a combination of decking and lawn creating space to dine, relax or entertain. At the rear of the garden, a substantial outbuilding offers excellent flexibility, whether you’re looking for a home office, studio, gym or additional storage.
What else?
Lloyd Park is just a short stroll away, home to the William Morris Gallery, landscaped gardens and the popular Saturday Farmers’ Market, one of Walthamstow’s best weekend destinations.
Walthamstow Village is within easy reach, where you’ll find independent favourites including Eat 17, The Kitchen and Orford Saloon, alongside a collection of cafés, pubs and boutiques.
Walthamstow Central station is easily accessible for Victoria line and Overground services, while the shops, restaurants and cinema along Hoe Street provide everything you need close to home.

Welcome to the Gardner House, Feltham, TW13 5, where luxury and convenience meet to offer you an exceptional living experience. This newly refurbished 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom duplex flat is now available for rent, offering an exquisite blend of modern living and prime location. Situated on the second floor, this property provides a serene retreat from the hustle and bustle, with the added advantage of free on-street parking. With a monthly rent of £2000.00, this property is ready to move in and awaits someone to call it home.
Boasting gas central heating, this duplex flat ensures cozy and comfortable living all year round. Nestled in a vibrant neighborhood, Gardner House is conveniently located close to schools, making it an ideal choice for families. The renowned Crane Park Primary School is a mere 0.43km away, while Heathfield Infant School and Bishop Perrin Church of England Primary School are also within close proximity, ensuring quality education for your children.
With public transport links within easy reach, commuting is a breeze. The Whitton, Ellerman Avenue bus stop is just 0.75km away, providing effortless connections to the surrounding areas. For those relying on rail travel, the Whitton, Fulwell, and Feltham stations are conveniently close, offering seamless access to wider destinations.
When it comes to amenities, you are spoiled for choice. St Clares and Tesco Express supermarkets are within 1.74km, while a variety of dining experiences await at KFC and Stellas Portuguese Cafe & Restaurant, both within 1km. For those who enjoy retail therapy, the Apex Retail Park is a mere 0.68km away, ensuring all your shopping needs are catered for.
Furthermore, this prime location offers access to essential services, including healthcare facilities such as the NHS Teddington Memorial Hospital and various general practitioners and pharmacies, all within a few kilometers. Fitness enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity of the David Lloyd Club and the Whitton Community Centre & Social Club, both within 1km, while entertainment options include the Cineworld London-Feltham cinema, just 1.98km away.
Surrounded by parks and recreation areas, including Crane Park and De Broome Fields, nature lovers and families have ample green spaces to explore and enjoy. The presence of local post offices, libraries, and attractions such as York House Gardens and the Royal Botanic Gardens further enhances the convenience of this location.
In conclusion, this duplex flat in Gardner House presents an exceptional opportunity to embrace a prosperous and vibrant lifestyle in a sought-after locale. Dont miss out on the chance to make this your new home and experience the best of what Feltham has to offer. Contact us today to arrange a viewing and secure this remarkable property.

The Good Shepherd Studios serves as a vibrant community cultural space hosting creative arts, yoga, and children's events, while the Pastures Youth Centre offers excellent sports facilities. Parents will also love The Can Club, a lovely local café designed specifically for children and parents to enjoy together.
Families will be further drawn to the area by the exceptional standard of local education. This combination of a well-connected home, an active community, and top-tier schools makes this an opportunity not to be missed.

properties.description:
Set on the residential Eversleigh Road, this well-proportioned three-bedroom house offers a practical family layout, plenty of natural light and one of East Ham's biggest advantages: almost everything you need is within easy reach.
Step inside and you'll find a bright and generously sized reception room, with a lovely bay window flooding the space with natural light. There's plenty of room to create both comfortable living and dining areas, making it a great space for everything from lazy Sunday afternoons to having friends and family over.
The separate galley-style kitchen offers a good amount of cupboard and worktop space, with appliances incorporated into the layout and plenty of scope for everyday cooking.
Upstairs are three bedrooms, including a spacious main bedroom alongside two additional rooms ideal as children's bedrooms, a guest room or home office.
The property also benefits from a family bathroom with bathtub and a separate WC, always a welcome addition when more than one person is trying to get ready in the morning!
And then there's the location…
Commuters are particularly well catered for, with both East Ham and Upton Park Underground stations approximately 0.4 miles away, providing access to the District and Hammersmith & City lines. Woodgrange Park Overground station is also around 0.9 miles away. 
Families have a strong selection of schools nearby, with Cleves Primary School only around 170 yards away, while St Stephen's Primary School and Hartley Primary School are also within approximately 0.3 miles. 
For a bit of greenery, Priory Park is approximately 0.2 miles away, while the larger Plashet Park is around 0.4 miles away, handy for walks, exercise or getting the kids out of the house. 
Everyday shopping is easy too. The surrounding area has 10+ food stores within half a mile, including Sainsbury's, Tesco Express and a wide range of independent grocers, cafés, restaurants and shops around High Street North. 
The highlights: three bedrooms, spacious reception room, separate fitted kitchen, family bathroom plus separate WC, excellent natural light, two Underground stations around 0.4 miles away, nearby parks, schools and a huge choice of local amenities.
**A proper East London home with space to spread out and everything you need close by. Early viewing recommended.**
This property is available with a Deposit Free option which means that instead of paying a traditional five weeks security deposit, you pay a fee of 28% of the first months rent + VAT (subject to a minimum of £120 + VAT) to become a member of a deposit free renting scheme which significantly reduces the up-front costs. This fee is non-refundable and is not a deposit so cannot be used towards covering the cost of any future damage.

The property features 3 spacious double bedrooms, a separate fitted kitchen, and a modern family bathroom, offering ample space for professionals, sharers, or small families. Large windows allow plenty of natural light to fill the rooms, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere.The apartment is ideally located directly opposite West Kensington Tube Station (District Line), just a one-minute walk away, making commuting effortless. 
The vibrant neighborhood provides easy access to Earl’s Court, Hammersmith, High Street Kensington, and Hyde Park, all within walking distance. Daily conveniences are covered with Tesco Kensington Superstore right on your doorstep, along with a variety of smaller shops, cafes, and restaurants nearby. Additional transport options include Barons Court, Kensington Olympia, and Earl’s Court Tube stations, all within a 10-minute walk, ensuring excellent connectivity across London.
Perfect for those who value convenience, space, and transport links, this apartment is an excellent choice for anyone looking to live in a prime West London location.
